Vault is a signed-in sidepanel surface and EXT-F-2011 already applies to member and admin; C01-C52/T01-T09 contain no device-enrollment equivalent. EXT-F-1012.verdict: accept a distinct host control/case, revise placement and scope wording
EXT-F-1012.basis: C01-C49/T01-T59 have no coverage for SavedReplayApprovalHost's subscribe-before-hydrate reconciliation, expiration notice/removal, or deny-on-unmount. The host is mounted at the shared sidepanel root inside AuthGate, and its source listens for extension-origin local pending confirmations across signed-in panel locations. T60 can remain admin-only for a saved network replay because data-pattern preparation carries cdp_attach.admin_only into the privileged operation requirements; this does not establish that the shared host itself is Showcase-only or unavailable to members.
EXT-F-1012.correction: Do not justify member inapplicability solely by EXT-F-1012/T38's Showcase audience denial. State the separate source basis: saved network replay's privileged cdp_attach requirement is admin-only, while the shared confirmation host is signed-in. Consider assigning the generic host control to the shared sidepanel/confirmation feature if one exists; otherwise describe C50 as local prepared-operation confirmation host and keep T60 bounded to saved replay host lifecycle. Page-load discovery also uses local prepared operations; keep its discovery behavior in T59 and avoid implying T60 tests that workflow or replay outcome.
